description: This file defines the SiloLifecycleSubject class, which extends LifecycleSubject to add logging and monitoring for silo lifecycle management in Orleans. It manages lifecycle stages, observers, and logs lifecycle events and performance metrics.

classes.name: SiloLifecycleSubject
classes.description: A class that manages and monitors the lifecycle stages of a silo, providing logging, tracking, and observer management.

classes.name: SiloLifecycleSubject.MonitoredObserver
classes.description: A nested class that wraps lifecycle observers to add logging for start and stop events and handle exceptions.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Overrides base method to log lifecycle stage reports at start.

methods.name: OnStartStageCompleted
methods.description: Updates the highest completed stage number.

methods.name: OnStopStageCompleted
methods.description: Updates the lowest stopped stage number.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Returns the stage name string for a given stage number.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStop
methods.description: Logs performance metrics when stopping a lifecycle stage.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStart
methods.description: Logs performance metrics when starting a lifecycle stage.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds an observer for a specific stage, wrapping it with MonitoredObserver for logging.
